messages:
Noah (Sales): Quick triage please — POC customer 'VantaCore' hit a stream of 429s during a bulk embeddings load. Demo in 2h. acct:VNT-301. Need fast mitigation and a short blurb I can send the customer.

Priya (SE): Which endpoint and what's the pattern? single-row calls or batched?

Noah (Sales): /v1/embeddings. They have ~30 workers, ~3 reqs/s each. App logs show: HTTP/1.1 429, X-RateLimit-Limit:120, X-RateLimit-Remaining:0, X-RateLimit-Reset:2411112300. Body: {"error":"rate_limited","detail":"per_route_cap exceeded"}.

Ken (Infra): per_route_cap exceeded — route bucket got drained by parallel single-item requests. Account quota still has headroom. Short term: reduce concurrency or grant a per-route reservation. Long term: batch the requests (64 items per call) to lower QPS.

Priya (SE): We can add a temporary route reservation. How much headroom do they need for the demo (duration)?

Noah (Sales): Demo run will peak ~90 rps for ~20 minutes. Could we add a short burst?

Marta (Oncall): I can apply +200 rps to /v1/embeddings for VNT-301 for 1 hour. Applying now and enabling extra logging for the session.

quota-bot: Temporary reservation applied: +200 rps to route "/v1/embeddings" for acct:VNT-301 until 2411115822. Ref: SUP-3140. :white_check_mark:

Noah (Sales): Thanks! Please send a one-liner I can paste to the customer confirming the change.

Marta (Oncall): Sent to customer: "We applied a temporary +200 rps reservation to your embeddings route for the upcoming demo (expires in 1 hour). For longer imports we recommend batching and/or requesting a trial reservation — SE will follow up."

Priya (SE): Customer guidance (quick): 1) switch to batched embeddings (up to 64 items/call) to reduce QPS; 2) add simple exponential backoff on 429s; 3) if you need predictable POC throughput, request a per-route reservation 24h before run. Example retry snippet (python):
```python
for i in range(5):
    r = client.embeddings.create(... )
    if r.status_code==429:
        sleep((2**i)*0.1 + random()*0.05)
        continue
    break
```

Ken (Infra): Two follow-ups for our side:
- add a POC "preflight" checkbox to SE playbook: expected QPS, request duration, batching feasibility
- evaluate offering a small opt-in trial reservation product for sandbox accounts

Noah (Sales): I'll update the customer ticket and include the retry snippet. They asked whether embeddings count against token budget differently — can someone confirm?

Priya (SE): Embeddings are charged per-item and also contribute to request-rate quotas. For bulk imports the effective QPS can be much higher if they do 1 request per row. We'll put that explanation into the POC checklist.

Marta (Oncall): Import completed at 2411112408, no further 429s observed. Leaving the reservation active until TTL for monitoring.

Noah (Sales): Demo team confirmed success. Please keep ticket SUP-3140 open for 24h monitoring and then auto-close.

Ken (Infra): I'll draft the trial reservation proposal and a short runbook note about batching -> per-item expansion and how to request temporary credits. Posting to #product tomorrow.

Noah (Sales): Great work everyone — fast and clean. Closing this thread once the ticket auto-closes. :rocket:
